main.description: isolyth.dev's decision (approve/deny) on a queued net.bisks.hyperobject.suggestion, written to her own repo as a stamped, publicly-verifiable checkpoint. src/index.ts's /api/review reads this record back off isolyth.dev's own PDS (rejecting any other author) before applying it: approve moves the suggestion's subject into the shared pit with suggestion credit, deny just drops it from the queue. One record per review decision. Written by isolyth.dev only; read by hyperobject (https://hyperobject.bisks.net).

suggestionUri.description: The at-uri of the net.bisks.hyperobject.suggestion record this decision is about.

decision.description: Whether the suggested soul was approved into the pit or denied.

createdAt.description: When this review decision was made, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
